prompt.reglas:
Pony Diffusion V6 XL: an SDXL finetune for anime, cartoon, furry and pony art (humanoid, anthro and feral characters).
After the score prefix the system adds, start with one source tag that matches the requested look: source_anime, source_cartoon, source_furry or source_pony.
Then describe what is wanted in one short plain-English phrase, then add comma-separated tags for the details: character, series, clothes, pose, expression, setting, lighting, framing.
Popular and obscure characters and series are known by name. Artist names are NOT known: never use them; describe the style instead.
Never add quality words (masterpiece, best quality, high quality, hd, 4k, 8k): the system already adds the score tags.
Keep it under about 60 words after the prefix.
The model rarely needs a negative prompt: write one only for something specific that must not appear, such as signature or text.
prompt.prefijo: score_9, score_8_up, score_7_up, score_6_up, score_5_up, score_4_up
